notes: English identifies the paired daggers/artifacts as Shine and Shadow, explicitly naming the pair in several quest records. Japanese uses シャイン&シャドウ or the corresponding “shine and shadow” wording; Chinese uses 光与影/光影之刃 as supporting evidence. Standardize the complete item name to 빛과 그림자(Shine and Shadow), preserving each sentence, particle, and existing owner disposition.

English uses Siegebreaker as a repeated personal epithet/title, including direct address and the prophecy pairing it with Deathbringer. Reuse the established Korean form 공성 파괴자(Siegebreaker); Japanese and Chinese renderings are corroborative only. Preserve all other titles, names, line breaks, and prior row dispositions.

English identifies Sioran Crypt as a named stronghold/site in the Drowned Forest. Japanese シオラン地下聖堂/シオランの墓所 and Chinese 赛欧澜地窖 corroborate the name but do not settle the exact architectural type. Standardize only the complete place name to 시오란 지하묘지(Sioran Crypt); retain the separate unresolved site-type/history findings.
